newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' markets closed for New Year.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' markets closed for New Year.

text.p: Indian metals' markets remained closed for the second successive day on Tuesday for the traditional Hindu New Year holidays and reopen on Wednesday, dealers said.
On Friday, prices were steady on dull trade ahead of the Diwali festival weekend, dealers said.

"Industrial demand remained low but limited arrivals kept the market quiet," one dealer said. "Trading activity will now only pick up after Diwali," said Sharad Parikh, President of the Bombay Metal Exchange.
